answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the mirror graph. Re-attestations are stored in vertex and wander lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1470 impostors cost 277 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
